## Featured

### [AMMPER](https://github.com/nasa/AMMPER)

Agent-based model of microbial cell populations exposed to ionizing deep-space radiation, developed in the NASA Ames Space Biosciences Division and validated against BioSentinel mission data. Later extended with gamma-radiation and metabolic-dye dynamics and a 3D free-radical diffusion model. The AMMPER-2 manuscript is under revision at the American Society for Microbiology ([preprint](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.08.757403)).

[Code](https://github.com/nasa/AMMPER) · [Fork](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/AMMPER)

### [Texas Children's Hospital Mentor Matching](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/tch-mentormatching)

Retrieval-augmented generation system that matches a mentee with Texas Children's Hospital mentors from a CV or an interest description. Private fork; available on request.

[Code](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/tch-mentormatching)

### [OverlapPlots](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/OverlapPlots)

R package for analyzing gene expression variations in neurological diseases, particularly synaptic dysfunction.

[Code](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/OverlapPlots)

## Clinical AI Evaluation Toolkit

Three open-source packages for evaluating and deploying large language models on clinical data:

### [clinval](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/clinval)

Validation harness for clinical LLM extraction: patient-window metrics with clustered confidence intervals, a frozen dev protocol, and error-mechanism analysis.

[Code](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/clinval)

### [fhirground](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/fhirground)

Grounded, validated FHIR R4 extraction from clinical notes: the LLM emits mentions with evidence quotes, deterministic code emits FHIR. No hallucinated codes, by construction.

[Code](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/fhirground)

### [ehrlint](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/ehrlint)

Lint your clinical prediction task before you train on it. Audits a finished MEDS or OMOP dataset for the leakage patterns that sink clinical prediction models — with the rows that prove it.

[Code](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/ehrlint)
